content.short: SafePal is a self-custody wallet with mobile, extension, and hardware products that support TON and many other assets.
content.description: SafePal combines a mobile app, browser extension, and hardware wallets for storing assets, signing transactions, and accessing dApps through one account system. The wallet stack supports self-custody, cross-chain asset management, swaps, NFT handling, and direct access to onchain services from one interface. In this TON listing, SafePal serves as a broad multi-chain wallet for holding Toncoin, managing transfers, and connecting to supported apps without being limited to a TON-only workflow or product surface.
content.meta: SafePal is a self-custody wallet with mobile, extension, and hardware products that support TON, swaps, NFTs, and multi-chain asset use.
